Predicates:
LanguageGenerationTask(x) ::: x is a language generation task.
LanguageUnderstandingTask(x) ::: x is a language understanding task.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
Premises:
∀x (OutputIsTextSequence(x) → LanguageGenerationTask(x)) ::: If the output of a task is a text sequence, then it is a language generation task.
MachineTranslation(x) ::: x is machine translation.
OutputIsTextSequence(x) ::: the output of x is a text sequence.
Conclusion:
∃x (MachineTranslation(x) ∧ OutputIsTextSequence(x)) ::: Machine translation is a natural language processing task with a text sequence output.
? :: Machine translation is a language understanding task.
